t: A list of what success is made of
a: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى صَلَاتِهِمْ خَـٰشِعُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ ٱللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَوٰةِ فَـٰعِلُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَـٰفِظُونَ
p: Qad aflaḥa-l-mu'minūn, alladhīna hum fī ṣalātihim khāshiʿūn…
m: Certainly will the believers have succeeded: They who are during their prayer humbly intent And they who turn away from ill speech And they who are observant of zakāh And they who guard their private parts
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
